name: Turks and Caicos Islands
summary_text: Turks and Caicos Islands: own legal system; decriminalised; resort envelope plus conservative island society. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of -0.04. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not the Turks and Caicos Islands; included as UK-context material (TCI is a British Overseas Territory).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not the Turks and Caicos Islands; included as UK-context material only.

sources.title: Being Gay in Turks & Caicos Islands
sources.claim_summary: GlobalGayz 'Being Gay in Turks & Caicos Islands' (May 2009): a resident's account - like 2/3 of the population he is not originally from TCI; the Belonger (full-citizen) population is a demographic minority versus foreigners; 'virtually nothing on the Internet about gay life in TCI'.

sources.title: Turks and Caicos Islands: Knowledge Base profile - GOV.UK
sources.claim_summary: UK HM Passport Office Knowledge Base profile for Turks and Caicos Islands (updated April 2025): nationality, legitimacy, adoption, gender recognition, civil partnerships and marriage, and documents - official UK guidance on the territory's legal framework.

TC Weekly News: landmark Court of Appeal ruling ordered a residence permit for Richard Sankar's same-sex spouse Timothy Haymon - 'spouse' in the Immigration Ordinance must include a same-sex spouse lawfully married elsewhere; violations of equality (s.7), non-discrimination (s.16) and private/family life (s.9) declared; but the court declined to change marriage law, citing the constitution's man-woman marriage definition (s.10) as lex specialis.

sources.title: LGBTQ rights in the Turks and Caicos Islands | Guide - Klshepedia | Klshepedia
sources.claim_summary: Klshepedia (Wikipedia-derived): LGBTQ rights in the Turks and Caicos Islands - same-sex activity legal since 2001; sexual-orientation discrimination constitutionally banned.
